components.label: orchestration
responsibilities: Discover and parse sources, run the collectors once per module, load the contract and assemble the observation the port publishes.
forbidden_responsibilities: Reading or writing an AST record itself; that stays with a named collector.

requires.rationale: `scanner` runs every collector once per parsed module to build one `ScanResult`, and `report` also calls `violations.requires_violations` directly to judge the assembled contract without adding a second collector call inside the scanner.

`scanner` parses sources and builds the shared symbol index before handing parsed modules to the collectors, and both `scanner` and `report` write through the shared record envelope, so orchestration reaches the same foundation the collectors it calls already depend on.

components.label: collectors
responsibilities: Read parsed sources and the shared symbol index, and write one kind of typed AST record each (AD-1); a peer nobody declared stays a peer nobody isolates (COLLECTORS-ISOLATED).
forbidden_responsibilities: Importing a sibling collector, discovering files, or deciding scan order.

requires.rationale: Every collector reads a `ParsedModule` and writes through the shared `RawRecord`/`RawEvidence` envelope so a record from `bindings` and one from `symbols` compare the same way; `calls` and `references` also resolve names through the shared symbol index, which each would otherwise reimplement one call site at a time.

components.label: foundation
responsibilities: Parse sources, build the symbol index, hold the stdlib receiver-type tables, run graph algorithms and hold the record envelope every collector writes through.
forbidden_responsibilities: Writing a typed AST record itself, or knowing which collector or entry point called it.

rules.rationale: Inside a component the same principle holds as above it: an import nobody asked for is an accident, so each part names what it needs and absence refuses the rest.
